notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted API first; moving to Dedicated POC to control latency and regional residency. Primary drivers: reduce token unit-cost for heavy embeddings + reranking workload and get deterministic p50 latency for chat-based in-product assistants.

Key contacts: CTO - Simon Kwan (wants latency <= 180ms p50 for UI chat flows), Head of ML - Priya Desai (POC owner), Infra Eng - Roberto Gomez (owns VPC/network).

POC scope (agreed): 4 weeks Dedicated POC. Goals: verify p50/p95 latency targets under realistic traffic, validate canary routing and rollback safety, prove cost per 1M tokens competitive vs hosted usage. Deliverables: perf report, cost model, canary runbook, security attestation.

Canary plan (technical notes):
- Week 1: dry-run with synthetic traffic on Dedicated pool; validate kernel selection and batching profiles.
- Week 2: 5% production traffic mirrored to Dedicated (no TTL) + A/B measurement; Redwood to enable continuous batching and KV prefix caching for top-50 prompts.
- Week 3: ramp to 25% traffic for low-latency routes (chat), keep embeddings and reranking on Hosted for cost comparison.
- Week 4: optional full-cutover test for a few routes, then rollback exercise.

Routing & fallback policy (required for POC):
- Primary: Dedicated regional pool (us-west-2) serving model variant rw-7b-fp16 for chat; rw-2b-q4 for cost-sensitive rerank tasks.
- Fallback chain: if Dedicated unhealthy or >300ms tail, route to Hosted API (redwood-curated-compat model) in us-east-1.
- Model variant downgrade: automated switch to quantized rw-7b-q4 when Dedicated GPU load >85% for 3 consecutive minutes; metric-based rollback to default model on recovery.
- Region failover: regional health check (3/10 failed probes) triggers cross-region routing to us-east-1 Dedicated pool; if capacity unavailable, fail open to Hosted API with alerting.

Rollback / safety playbook:
- Immediate rollback knob: AE/SE can flip traffic percentage to 0% for Dedicated route from Console (board-level access).
- State sync: cache KV prefix flush is a no-op for stateless chat; for conversation state we’ll replicate session keys to Hosted if full rollback required.
- Post-incident steps: collect token-level traces, rollout logs, and push to shared Drive folder; Redwood SE to raise RW ticket if kernel OOM or inference errors.

Security & compliance notes:
- Requires VPC peering + private endpoints for Dedicated. KMS integration planned for session tokens. Need explicit retention controls (30 / 90 day options) in contract. Legal asked for SOC2 audit report and data residency appendix.

Cost / commercial:
- BlueQuartz target ARR range for vendor selection: $150k-300k. Finance pushed back on committed monthly minimum; asked for burst credits. Pricing appendix v1 in Drive.

Quotes / customer voice: "If we can get p50 < 180ms and keep costs within 50% of our hosted spend, we can move to Dedicated." — Simon K.

- Legal to confirm data residency clause (action: BQ legal, due 2026-03-10).
- Confirm SSO mapping and test service account in staging (action: Daniel, due 2026-03-05).
